items.title: Einspruch against income tax assessment
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterwolgast ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Bescheid dated/posted 20.11.2026 (Friday), no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date given, so posting day = 20.11.2026. Bekanntgabefiktion for letters posted from 1 Jan 2025: delivered on the 4th calendar day after posting. 20.11.+4 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). Since this is a Finanzamt, if that day were a Sat/Sun/holiday it would move to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO), but 24.11.2026 is an ordinary Tuesday, so Bekanntgabe = 24.11.2026. One-month Einspruchsfrist (§355 Abs.1 AO) counted under §§187,188 BGB ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is a normal working day in Germany (not a statutory holiday), so no further adjustment under §108 Abs.3 AO/§193 BGB is needed.
